programme.desc: 學生們接受數字、動物、人物的歇後語考驗，能否「話頭醒尾」？廖舜禧講解俗語「包尾」寫法及「燉冬菇」出處；鄭寶鴻解讀歇後語「五十斤柴」。主持還走訪遮廠、醬園與藥材舖，瞭解與雨傘、豉油、中藥相關的歇後語。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 雞年新正頭，三位主持找來藝員黃建東扮財神，在安老院進行歇後語問答遊戲，長者們有多精靈？「逗利是」為新春指定動作，利是另有利市、利事的寫法，而利市較符合傳統，大學講師廖舜禧詳析字義；他還細數「三姑」、「六婆」代表的古代職業女性。主持們走訪海味店與繡莊，瞭解「髮菜炒荳芽」、「大力士繡花」等相關歇後語。日用品收藏家的珍藏，又令主持想起甚麼歇後語？「濕水炮仗」形容性情和善的人，掌故專家鄭寶鴻講述當中出處。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 客席主持潘文迪為這場大玩特玩運動會擔任評判。運動場上用腳「劃」龍舟，還要踏上石春路及穿越山洞，何解翟威廉玩到毫無表情？運動員身體套上麻包袋，頭頂大碗運送乒乓球，陳嘉桓初嚐玩遊戲氣餒的感覺，比賽結果更是令人失望透頂！廢界紀錄保持者連詩雅玩人肉冰壺時，竟將同伴推跌，表現一貫連戲。特玩隊僥倖連勝三回合，但一場多人多足遊戲，竟令大玩隊成功出線爭獎品。最後擲飛碟贏獎品，楊潮凱身為遊戲之王，為何空手而回？

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 本集飼養員們分享照顧老年大熊貓的日常，包括給牠們量血壓、量體重、餵藥和定期剪指甲，每一項工作都不容易。飼養員還想起照顧的老年熊貓離世時的心情等等，令他們更珍惜與熊貓相處的時光，亦為成為飼養員感到驕傲。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 黛雅跑去找許久不見的虹之咲。但虹之咲卻為了跟奇蹟閃耀組商討節目內容而不在。目睹虹之咲與閃耀組日益親密，黛雅對閃耀組心生妒忌，更決定挖出未來、繪萌、凜花三人不可告人的祕密……

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 明天就是寶石時裝大賽，閃亮宿各處都熱鬧非凡。以未來為首的一眾參賽者，紛紛收到親友的加油打氣，並專注於最後的練習及調整。至於杏樹與虹之咲，也分別向艾菈、未來傾訴了對寶石時裝大賽的想法。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄一家計劃去賞花，卻因爸爸臨時有工作而取消，「景色更換器」讓大雄可以安坐家中賞花。大雄明知時間不夠仍去午睡，得知沒有法寶用才急得發慌，多啦A夢拿出「時光火把」讓他感受時間的流逝。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星團粵日
programme.desc: MooNs正在準備拍攝他們的新歌MV，但隨著個人的工作增加，成員們要聚在一起變得越來越困難，所有人好不容易騰出時間一起拍攝，詎料器材卻出現問題，令他們只能眼睜睜看著寶貴的時間分秒流失。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 上海早餐選擇多，婭溦、糖妹大清早排隊，只為品嚐熱辣辣蔥油餅。「炸串兄弟」的炸鵪鶉蛋與炸年糕撒滿汁醬，超可口！點一客全家福大餛飩，體現滬式餛飩文化。到達「咖啡街」永康路，二人分途覓食，開展半日文青之旅。浴室裝潢的小店，婭溦甜試可愛肥皂慕絲蛋糕；泡茶店的粟米雪糕，必喫。糖妹搭訕叔叔，獲邀乘坐非一般電單車兜風！她還光顧復古咖啡廳，享受片刻寧靜。路邊卡位會合，她們享用香草腰果、鹹蛋黃流心千層蛋糕，好放鬆！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 清明、初一十五拜神後，剩下不少燒肉？肥媽發揮好「煮意」，採用燒肉配上豆腐，以及6號笑稱為「後宮偏方」的韭菜，煮成「大馬站煲」。硬豆腐吸盡煲內精華，美味提升！一道<兩椰雞將椰青水和椰子水一同熬煮，份外鮮甜。肥媽今集還會帶6號前往果欄選食材，原來芒果有公乸之分？肥媽以口感結實的水仙芒，炮製<芒果芥末蝦球，並帶來處理蝦肉的小祕訣。運用打麵機自製麵條，再以慢火煎出的滋味甜品<糖醋麵餅，6號先喫為快！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 香港有不少像6號般的「牛魔王」，肥媽特意準備了一頓全牛宴。「食肉獸」亦可食得健康，阿媽以高纖燕麥通粉配上番茄、薯仔與牛肉碎，即可成為美味的營養餐。牛尾加入花生醬燜煮，惹味層次驟升；6號突然提出隔水燜牛尾的烹調方法，錯誤下廚知識當然換來肥媽取笑！要令菜式更加「牛氣衝天」，肥媽教大家用牛膏代替食油起鑊，並帶來「豆瓣醬炒牛肉眼」。煮「牛骨白蘿蔔湯」時，阿媽把數粒黑色香料入鍋中，究竟是甚麼「法寶」？

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族羣體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，瞭解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵
programme.desc: 眾星戲癮發作，合演特工小劇場，旨在介紹逾百年歷史的特工主題餐廳。桌上甫見到豬肉的肥膏，朱仔隨即想起陳瀅？深入文創藝術村買手信，女生盡顯默契；四人更一起DIY手繩，陳瀅卻嫌JW破壞文青氣氛？走進聚集年輕人的市集，陳瀅獲飾品店主贈送禮物，令嘉洛要向店主問明原因！店主的熱情舉動反讓陳瀅歉疚，她即為三名拍檔買禮物，卻差點因為一隻卡通玩偶激怒朱仔？去泰國梗要按摩！兩女久候嘉洛、朱仔，要化身按摩女郎戲弄他們！

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵
programme.desc: 眾主持登上雙龍寺參拜，順道俯瞰清邁市風景。來到小孩遊樂場，嘉洛童心大發，陳瀅勉強陪玩，JW自認老了？兩男試玩人造沖浪卻跌不停，嘉洛還遇上小意外，引來女拍檔們追究？邊喫邊聊，JW揭露陳瀅曾致電向她哭訴。泰式餐廳設有一個園林美景，眾人彷如置身於仙境中用餐。怎料嘉洛餐後大意遺下銀包，被陳瀅手抓到報復機會……入夜返回酒店，大家齊集玩問答遊戲。一條誰人最有義氣的問題，陳瀅的答案卻令兩男傷心「中箭」？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 陸浩明(6號)擁有豐富主持經驗，腦筋靈活而且口才了得。這次他向甜品達人古嘉俊「埋手」，請教製作「香蕉牛奶軟心朱古力」的祕訣，務求提升自己成為全方位一家之「煮」！阿古製作甜品向來創意十足，就連所用的器具也令人意想不到，這次他竟然拿出了一個浴室用的電風筒，到底有何用意？製作香蕉甜品往往難以突出其既香且甜的味道，阿古可有方法解決？及後，「6號」亦會分享他的製作心得，暢談做甜品與學「書法」的微妙關係。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 太晴班上要分組發表關於大宮的歷史報告，機緣巧合下與良太及茜組成一組，但茜表示無意跟二人合作。新的未知出現，結果雖戰勝，但良太推斷仍需要多打兩場。高輪告知捕獲未知時出現的傷者是茜。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 六位女生為本集「My Little Show」獻唱勵志歌曲<You raise me up，並分享利用椅子與公仔作輔助的訓練方法，相當有趣。另一組女生則手持扇子表演芭蕾舞，動作優雅又帶童趣。<Five Little Ducks和<白石嶺公園陪伴不少人成長，這回由結他導師與主持姐姐合唱兩首經典兒歌。此外，導師還淺談結他除了用木製作外，原來亦可由碳纖維或紙皮等物料製成。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 粗頸在健身室與孩子們嬉戲，不慎弄傷頸項，休息一星期後，頸項竟嚴重萎縮，聲音也變得尖銳，然而回到警察局，他卻驚見有另一個自己在執勤，其他人都不相信他是粗頸，更嘲笑他是「幼頸」。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 除夕當日，媽媽託小丸子去買御節料理的材料，詎料後者買了一隻伊勢龍蝦回來。小丸子被大罵一頓，不過伊勢龍蝦始終賣相一流，媽媽最終還是感謝小丸子。然而眾人喫畢龍蝦後便對御節料理失去興趣。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 潛行天下粵
programme.desc: 《潛行天下》以全球海洋為主題，採用8K超高清攝影機和水下無人機等技術建構沉浸式觀影體驗，跨越四大洋14國水域拍攝，記錄雙髻鯊、鯨鯊等海洋生物活動，探密三沙永樂龍洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 本港近年興起懷舊潮，但對於一些人來說並非潮流，而是數十年的追求。有人變賣物業，四處搜尋承載香港回憶的舊物；有人走訪老店，記錄不同店舖幾代人的傳承和堅守；亦有人投入一生心血，親手製作具有香港特色的食物和器具。為甚麼他們堅持保留舊工藝、舊物品？要傳承和保育本地文化，他們又付出了甚麼？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」瞭解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 夾公仔舖失竊，遭盜走的竟是CCTV裝置！女事主攜兩子在藍田乘小巴，因拍卡繳費問題與司機起爭執；其後，司機突然關門不讓事主下車，變相將先下車的小朋友獨留街頭；該司機如何回應？某大廈三樓單位近月出現滲漏，牆身發黴、天花滴水，更隨時有漏電危險！漏水似源於四樓，攝製隊卻查悉三、四樓共多達十戶受影響，四樓走廊亦浸濕可見積水。專家檢測後判斷大廈是淡水「垂直滲漏」，最終找出源頭……陳慧琳為新歌拍MV，送上花絮。

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻:中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 36強啟動一連三集的導師分組賽，紅隊布志綸、紫隊高少華、綠隊張嘉銘三位導師親自挑選組員，並悉心指導眾人提升音樂實力，再於舞臺上盡情發揮。這集分為三個回合，各組代表分別獨自演繹關淑怡、王傑與陶喆的歌曲，並將有一人被淘汰。此外，備受觀眾關注的蒙面藝人選手亦會於本輪開唱前揭開面具，其中的貓女郎、白羊君更會於這集登場，首次於無面具阻隔下唱歌，表現如何？

programme.title: 一週星星粵PG
programme.desc: 陳家樂、張繼聰參演警匪電影，片內槍戰連連，阿聰坦言要做到「殺人不眨眼」難度高！家樂則要靠方中信指導開槍，自覺持槍姿態略欠神韻。阿聰用胸肌猜枚令劇迷印象深刻，他憶述該場口播放前，自己的心路歷程，並慶幸女兒可能未看過？阿聰還希望翻看某次為慈善親身表演的片段？重看跟太太連詩雅的定情作品，家樂對初認識的對方印象欠佳？詩雅於錄音大讚家樂在家中一個舉動，家樂卻笑言是為勢所迫，更反問為宣傳電影竟要用生命講真話？

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 星廚陳佑良帶波波試喫特色「頭盔」煲仔飯，能完整起鍋的飯焦特別香脆，還有薯角單骨雞翼，嫩滑爆汁。居港日本人帶何泳芍造訪「人氣」餐廳，品嚐外脆內嫩的厚切燒牛舌，媲美日本知名牛舌餐廳的招牌菜！行仔、施焯日繼續土瓜灣「掃街」之旅，遍嚐傳統砵仔糕、香脆多汁的海苔肉鬆煎餃，以及特大芝士菠蘿包，都是不可錯過的地道小食。韓國「人氣」雪糕店登陸本港，「爆餡」杜拜朱古力Q餅搭配乳酪雪糕，配料豐富，每一口都是驚喜享受！

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 疊影狙擊#4粵PG
programme.desc: 曉晨查到爆炸案與Dicky有關，決定接近他，與他到酒店房間約會，並成功在利民擔任經理，以便打探消息。晟傑覺得曦回港後異常，便讓下屬去調查她，發現她與環保團體Green World有關係；同時曉晨也查出了同樣的線索…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 夾公仔舖失竊，遭盜走的竟是CCTV裝置！女事主攜兩子在藍田乘小巴，因拍卡繳費問題與司機起爭執；其後，司機突然關門不讓事主下車，變相將先下車的小朋友獨留街頭；該司機如何回應？某大廈三樓單位近月出現滲漏，牆身發黴、天花滴水，更隨時有漏電危險！漏水似源於四樓，攝製隊卻查悉三、四樓共多達十戶受影響，四樓走廊亦浸濕可見積水。專家檢測後判斷大廈是淡水「垂直滲漏」，最終找出源頭……陳慧琳為新歌拍MV，送上花絮。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族羣體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，瞭解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 喫貨橫掃曼谷粵
programme.desc: 澄光、星妤偕慧中分途覓食，孖妹在街頭找到炭火蛋糕仔，澄光則獨享融合中泰風味的茶記早餐。Cafe位於著名購物商場內，以花園風格佈置適合打卡，食品亦具質素，讓大家可於「血拼」期間休息一番。海鮮粥店外會掛起大魚作招徠，店裡粥品亦鮮味十足。唐人街內的潮州菜館，大廚堅持用炭爐炒菜，炮製出蠔餅、菜脯蛋、炸蝦棗等佳餚。此外，手製「榴槤雪糕」又有多香滑？入夜，主持們在高空酒吧回顧這趟曼谷之旅，各有甚麼深刻行程？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 周嘉洛、陳瀅、JW王灝兒、朱敏瀚約好去旅行，怎料嘉洛要拍劇而未能同遊？三人帶着失望抵達清邁酒店，酒店員工中有一奇怪身影，縱近距離遇上，仍未察覺有異？走進咖啡店，大家邊喝特飲邊談夢想，JW提議陳瀅可用腳踩葡萄釀紅酒？及後品嚐泰式甜品，朱仔一時口快，氣得陳瀅掟羹？來到田野，兩男親自動手製作鐵桶燒雞，好惹味。行逛當地夜市，JW、朱仔實試火焰按摩。合力幫朱仔完成此行的願望清單，朱仔竟要拍檔相伴一起食蟲……

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 陸浩明(6號)擁有豐富主持經驗，腦筋靈活而且口才了得。這次他向甜品達人古嘉俊「埋手」，請教製作「香蕉牛奶軟心朱古力」的祕訣，務求提升自己成為全方位一家之「煮」！阿古製作甜品向來創意十足，就連所用的器具也令人意想不到，這次他竟然拿出了一個浴室用的電風筒，到底有何用意？製作香蕉甜品往往難以突出其既香且甜的味道，阿古可有方法解決？及後，「6號」亦會分享他的製作心得，暢談做甜品與學「書法」的微妙關係。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 上海早餐選擇多，婭溦、糖妹大清早排隊，只為品嚐熱辣辣蔥油餅。「炸串兄弟」的炸鵪鶉蛋與炸年糕撒滿汁醬，超可口！點一客全家福大餛飩，體現滬式餛飩文化。到達「咖啡街」永康路，二人分途覓食，開展半日文青之旅。浴室裝潢的小店，婭溦甜試可愛肥皂慕絲蛋糕；泡茶店的粟米雪糕，必喫。糖妹搭訕叔叔，獲邀乘坐非一般電單車兜風！她還光顧復古咖啡廳，享受片刻寧靜。路邊卡位會合，她們享用香草腰果、鹹蛋黃流心千層蛋糕，好放鬆！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 清明、初一十五拜神後，剩下不少燒肉？肥媽發揮好「煮意」，採用燒肉配上豆腐，以及6號笑稱為「後宮偏方」的韭菜，煮成「大馬站煲」。硬豆腐吸盡煲內精華，美味提升！一道<兩椰雞將椰青水和椰子水一同熬煮，份外鮮甜。肥媽今集還會帶6號前往果欄選食材，原來芒果有公乸之分？肥媽以口感結實的水仙芒，炮製<芒果芥末蝦球，並帶來處理蝦肉的小祕訣。運用打麵機自製麵條，再以慢火煎出的滋味甜品<糖醋麵餅，6號先喫為快！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 香港有不少像6號般的「牛魔王」，肥媽特意準備了一頓全牛宴。「食肉獸」亦可食得健康，阿媽以高纖燕麥通粉配上番茄、薯仔與牛肉碎，即可成為美味的營養餐。牛尾加入花生醬燜煮，惹味層次驟升；6號突然提出隔水燜牛尾的烹調方法，錯誤下廚知識當然換來肥媽取笑！要令菜式更加「牛氣衝天」，肥媽教大家用牛膏代替食油起鑊，並帶來「豆瓣醬炒牛肉眼」。煮「牛骨白蘿蔔湯」時，阿媽把數粒黑色香料入鍋中，究竟是甚麼「法寶」？

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 本集飼養員們分享照顧老年大熊貓的日常，包括給牠們量血壓、量體重、餵藥和定期剪指甲，每一項工作都不容易。飼養員還想起照顧的老年熊貓離世時的心情等等，令他們更珍惜與熊貓相處的時光，亦為成為飼養員感到驕傲。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#45粵
programme.desc: 婷成績滑落，家人協助婷，但卻愈幫愈忙，令蕙婷苦不堪言。朋提讓婷報讀補習班，可是當婷上課回來，眾人發現所謂「補習天王」的精讀班未能吸收到知識。慶決定陪婷到補習班，更與「補習天王」徐Sir即場比賽中史。

programme.title: 天龍八部#17粵普PG
programme.desc: 蕭峯逐漸適應遼闊林野的生活，並與女真族建立了交情。有一天，十多名族人邀蕭峯一起打獵，不料遇到遼兵，蕭峯以一己之力擊退遼兵，成功擒住耶律洪基，其武功及氣度令耶律洪基心懷敬佩，二人相談甚歡，決定結為兄弟。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺與阿譚往大澳搜羅鹽爆魚肚，先用來炮製酒樓點心「棉花雞」。筒形魚肚捲入雞件、臘腸、芋頭等食材，吸盡餡料美味精華。接着將魚肚切絲，配上豆角、蝦仁等製作「桂花魚肚」，兜炒食材後下蛋漿，控制火候，令粒粒「桂花」黏在食材上。冬至到，豪一豪，跟鼎爺到街市挑選龍蝦做節。鼎爺將龍蝦起肉切片，然後混合雞湯和蛋白，「藏入」龍蝦肉蒸煮。再配以蒸熟的龍蝦頭、尾，即成「白雪藏龍」。也可選用龍蝦頭熬湯代替雞湯，原汁原味！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 鼻竇炎患者可透過鼻涕顏色分辨嚴重性，長年累月亦有可能長出鼻瘜肉，鹽水洗鼻會否是緩解病情之法？耳鼻喉專科醫生再補充，治療方案上或要施手術以去除鼻瘜肉。正氣被指對免疫能力有幫助，但何謂正氣？又如何藉此改善上呼吸道的健康？粵劇花旦謝曉瑩亮相受訪，細談自小對粵劇的熱愛，更因參與《合曬合尺》節目而鋪墊入行之路。她還一試自組劇團，做班主有甚麼困難？「睇餸食飯」，李家鋌師傅以優質肉材，炒出「泡菜芝士和牛炒飯」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在廣州粵
programme.desc: 廣州，粵菜發源地之一，廣府菜的中心，是每一位食客都無法拒絕的美食聖地。愛喫愛玩的主持人麥包，在廣州徹底釋放了喫貨天性，走遍大街小巷，尋找地道美食：悠閑早茶、西關小喫、新潮佳饌，夜市小攤

programme.title: 單戀雙城#18粵
programme.desc: 書舒與式適發現Lois的貨售價很高，不明她何以用低價賣貨給書舒。式適與恭梓分別來到逼展禛說出真相，展禛打電話求救後展博現身。以蕎為電影主題曲錄音，豈料老闆改用新人主唱，經理人認為唯一反擊方法是作好歌。

programme.title: 灼熱卡巴迪粵日
programme.desc: 佐倉終於產生了王牌的自覺，憑一次來勢洶洶的進攻，獲得難以置信的大量得分，令能京士氣大受打擊。唯獨宵越不為所動，嘗試以進攻扭轉局勢，更對佐倉施展新招式，震撼全場，然而，佐倉還是成功攔截了他……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 2026年3月3日黃昏，香港有機會出現月全食，屆時抬頭或望到血紅色的月球。「Kids’ Notes」請來天文愛好者，提供相關資訊，讓大家可捕捉到這珍貴現象，否則就要等到2028年年尾！此外，嘉賓亦帶來月球儀與一些月球相關物品，引領大家一同探祕。人類在地球上永遠只能看到月球的一面？月球溫差有幾大？月球表面有不少坑洞，原來為地球擋下了無數殞石碎片？AI生成動畫環節，這集播放《愚公移山》的上半部份。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄忘記做功課，並揚言有多一天時間必定會補做，多啦A夢借他「提前延遲栗子」把期限延遲。大雄諸事不順，接連遇到阻滯，多啦A夢於是借他「借用膠貼」，貼上後可以把對象暫時完全借用。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 週年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 葵涌私樓不多，其中一個屋苑，環境清幽，吸引區內家庭客，樓價於甚麼水平？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 保誠保險呈獻：AI時代，讓子女世界放大粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2754粵
programme.desc: 敢威原本封給Ceci的「大利是」不知去向，內有一張並未填寫銀碼的支票。由於同款利是隻會封給家人，敢威懷疑自己不小心掉換了，遂嘗試尋回，但始終未有發現。敢威其後知悉同款利是給了瑞素，但因某些理由未能找璟風為他取回利是，只好另想辦法，卻屢試不果。另邊廂，瑞素有不少發現，懷疑敢威「出招」要破壞她與璟風的戀情，城安提到她應向敢威報復！後來，敢威驚覺支票戶口遭人提取鉅款，幾近清零……

programme.title: 臥底嬌娃#6粵
programme.desc: 佳琪、妙姿和小茹於《超星女團》初選險被淘汰，妙姿機智自救，最終入圍。奕風做PA暗中輔助，三女在後臺結識寶儀，留下好印象。卡邦妮來探班，反令女兒寶儀遭受質疑。奕風偷到劉彪的手機作檢查，歸還時撞見劉彪與白學年等人會面，並發現戒指似是社團信物。寶儀被小圈子針對，更被質疑靠後臺入圍。寶儀不知所措，三女為寶儀出頭發聲。寶儀失去拍檔欲退賽，被三女勸說留下並一起組隊。三女帶寶儀到鬧市表演，助寶儀重拾自信。

programme.title: 歡樂茶飯#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 林晏終於找到趙荀之，準備帶他離開時，李昂早已在門口等候，林晏奮力戰鬥，負傷逃出，遇上韶光兄妹倆後隨即暈倒。醫師指林晏傷勢太嚴重，無法救治，韶光提議進行縫合，但醫師根本不會做，林晏提出讓韶光親自動手…

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：攻你上大學粵
programme.desc: 問到「飛」字的部首，《飛常日誌II》眾演員應該對這字非常熟識，劉穎鏇、吳偉豪卻不知何謂「部首」！倪樂琳、梁凱晴、朱敏瀚更從輸入法角度去拆解？四個選項中，哪一個不是中國的少數民族？周嘉洛因「布朗」似英文譯音而揀選，推斷可會正確？某人弄不清修辭手法，驚訝其他九人都答對，這挫折令其甚感無癮……「升中」後第一條題目，「女神」級學生的答案明明與大部份人一樣，但強調自己有用腦做選擇，還解釋得頭頭是道！

programme.title: 樓盤新視野之走進黃金海灣粵
娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#14粵
programme.desc: 少龍等到達魏國大梁，信陵君與家將來接。龍陽君出城接師傅鄒衍及師妹琴清，為封城一事與信陵君爭拗，少龍解圍令龍陽君生好感。少龍向信陵君坦言知其陰謀，又說想投靠他。連晉向嫪毐拜師遭戲弄。少龍為查祕錄下落，故意打草驚蛇，在岸邊見貌似秦青的女子，追上去卻芳蹤杳然。龍陽君安置雛衍及琴清暫住水榭，雛衍夜觀星象，發現新聖人將誕生。少龍偷得祕錄，信陵君突然折返，少龍逃至水榭並躲在書房，赫見與秦青一模一樣的琴清。

programme.desc: 網上瘋傳即將有超級寒流來襲，元宵有可能出現落雪景象。璟風、瑞素等「有情人」滿心期待；尚善卻顯得不屑，似乎看不過眼眾人沉醉於節日的浪漫。另一方面，敢佳一反常態，在Cafe推出「震撼」優惠套餐，吸引大批人搶購。尚善察覺有古怪，其後終於揭開敢佳背後的真正意圖，原來另有內情！尚善與敢佳目標一致，提出一個可助他達成願望的方法……元宵當晚，寒流果然來襲，眾人滿心期待白色元宵，尚善卻設法「搞破壞」……

programme.title: 臥底嬌娃#7粵PG
programme.desc: 三女送飲醉的寶儀回家，成功與劉彪、邦妮建立初步關係。權世傑跟隨世豪的指示設局；華叔獄中病發，被送往明成北醫院。同時，私煙強、劉彪等亦分別因傷被送到明成北。奕風趕到明成北，向世傑提出更周詳的計劃。學年陪卡大韋到明成北檢查身體；三女趕到醫院，奕風着三人留意劉彪的舉動。私煙強突然逃出，奕風追截，私煙強告知是受名叫克洛索帕之人指使，但粉精靈配方紙不翼而飛。《超星女團》總決賽舞臺，受傷的寶儀盡力綻放自己……

programme.title: 歡樂茶飯#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 趙王挾持韶光逼林晏放走李昂後被林晏刺死，崔家沉冤得雪，林晏被彈劾要問斬，韶光經長公主提點用法度救林晏。沈家人發現畫師為林晏和韶光畫的畫像與祠堂掛著的相同，韶傑想起爺爺說過林晏不是祖宗，林晏和韶光成婚。

programme.desc: 來自《飛常日誌II》的七位學生升中後，被問及關於機場新設施「天際走廊」，僅一人答錯。此外，四人於中學階段連續四題答對，包辦升上大學的名額。大學題莫非太難？四位大學生之中，僅一位會揀自己答，有人卻不為意資優生持「反彈」錦囊，答題或要拜託運氣之神保佑！停電時因大廈壞電梯致受傷，應向誰索償？文靜老師提議「報東張」，答題者覺得要找個與「電」無關的單位，被Bob評為亂答！這學生更只憑一句歌詞推敲地理題答案？

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S1(完)
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的巖漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的巖漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 陷入純情(完)
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與樸海鎮領銜，知名主角羣展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神祕性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師樸海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神祕又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這羣「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S2
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的巖漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與樸海鎮領銜，知名主角羣展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神祕性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師樸海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神祕又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這羣「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate

programme.desc: God’s Gang faces insane challenges - from stopping a mad scientist to battling aliens and saving blue whales.

programme.desc: Oh no, Jeremy ran out of gas! Troy selects the most perfect truck to refuel him: Tyson the Tanker!

programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.desc: Lilly and Tom are stuck in the snow! Troy selects the most perfect truck for the job: Sam the Snowplough!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.title: Complicity
programme.desc: Inspired by a real-life incident. Cheng Liang, a Chinese illegal immigrant in Japan finds new direction when he fakes his identity and lands an apprenticeship with a master soba chef. However, the threat of deportation always lurks around the corner.

programme.title: Top Dogs
programme.desc: A dramedy about two estranged brothers from Normandy. Antoine is happily married with two kids and a successful boat driver, whereas Christian is a globe-trotting hustler. When Antoine becomes involved in sleazy activities, Christian comes to his rescue.

programme.title: Deep In The Wood
programme.desc: During the Krampus festival, little Tommi disappears mysteriously in the woods. He is found 5 years later in a building site on the outskirts of Naples, but his parents and the town locals are suspicious and frightened by his strange behaviour.

programme.title: Running On Sand
programme.desc: When an Eritrean refugee about to be deported from Israel is mistaken for the Nigerian striker just signed to a struggling soccer team, his fate depends on the team’s success in this charming, socially relevant dramedy.

programme.title: Ghost Mountaineer
programme.desc: In the former Soviet Union, a group of Estonian students go hiking in Siberia. After their unpopular leader Olle vanishes, his rival Eero leads the group to seek help, and a series of bizarre and terrifying events unfold.

programme.title: Until Tomorrow
programme.desc: A single mother's courage is tested when she resorts to desperate measures to hide her illegitimate child from her parents.

programme.title: Oddball
programme.desc: An eccentric chicken farmer, with the help of his granddaughter, trains his mischievous dog Oddball to protect a penguin sanctuary from fox attacks in an attempt to reunite his family and save their seaside town.

programme.title: Sweet Dreams
programme.desc: Dutch tycoon Jan dies suddenly in Indonesia, leaving his wife Agathe in shock. Their son and his pregnant wife come from the Netherlands to inherit the family empire and are dismayed to find out that Jan's mistress Siti has a crucial role in his will.

programme.title: Like Crazy
programme.desc: Two mental patients, a motor-mouthed fantasist and a tattooed introvert, who met at a community hospital, fled the hospital to embark on a road trip from Tuscany to Rome, in search of love and happiness in the open-air nuthouse - the world of sane people.

programme.title: To My Beloved
programme.desc: Fernando is a good man who takes care of his only child, Daniel. Following the death of his wife Ana, every night Fernando recalls their love as he sorts out his beloved dead spouse’s belongings. One day he finds a VHS tape that will change everything.

programme.desc: When Dad's accused of fluffing in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Mountain Gorillas
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout explore Uganda's impenetrable forests on a global adventure to find a new baby gorilla who's just learning how to climb and forage for himself.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Towel
programme.desc: Bella plays funny games with Lift using her colourful towel. Together, they visit Hettie in the Ice Disco, who uses a big towel to make up a new dance - the Butterfly Boogie!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Listening Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels hear a strange sound that they've not heard before, so they ask Duggee to help identify it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Choir Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels become enchanted when they hear a piece of music from Duggee's choir. They quickly learn what makes a choir.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Feelings Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels notice that Happy isn't acting like his normal self, and he's strangely wearing new trainers. Happy doesn't know what he's feeling, and his friends want to help him.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Maasai Mara National Park, Kenya
programme.desc: The team roars into action as Glitch tries to take a selfie with a lion in the Maasai Mara.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Cappadocia, Turkey
programme.desc: A game of hide and seek threatens to topple the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia in Turkey.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Thomas' Fuzzy Friend
programme.desc: When Thomas discovers a missing dog rummaging around the railway yard, he tries to find the dog a new home.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Hair Cut
programme.desc: Sarah's hair keeps getting in her way, so it's time for a trip to the hairdressers.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Arcade Dance Off
programme.desc: Stumbling across an arcade, Sarah takes on a dancing challenge with John, whilst Duck and Flamingo team up to try and defeat a video game!

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - First Aid
programme.desc: Myrtle calls Stanley to see if she can practice her first aid skills on him, but he's all fit and healthy. Instead, they go about the town making good use of Myrtle's newfound abilities.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Bug Hotel
programme.desc: Benjamin and Sophie have a new bug friend. Stanley helps build a bug feeder which attracts lots more bugs. They eat so much; Stanley gets more food and builds a Bug Hotel for them.

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Goal
programme.desc: Libby plays a game of football with her teddies. The pink team score lots of goals through the wide goals, but the orange team aren't scoring any through their narrow goals.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Visit the Optician
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran take a trip to have JoJo's eyes tested at the opticians. Jaxon and Ezra help explain what it means to be long- and short-sighted.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Pottery Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is having a lovely cup of tea in his favourite cup when Roly surprises him with a very loud peek-a-boo! It is so loud that Duggee jumps and drops his cup which shatters into pieces.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Honey Badge
programme.desc: Duggee's made some delicious pancakes, but the clubhouse is out of honey. Time for the bees to get busy!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Valley Of The Balls, Kazakhstan

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Maasai Mara National Park, Kenya
programme.desc: The team roars into action as Glitch tries to take a selfie with a lion in the Maasai Mara.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - The Great Little Railway Show
programme.desc: When a Railway Show for little engines comes to Sodor, an overly excited Percy finally sees his chance to shine.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Constable Quack
programme.desc: After their snacks go missing, Sergeant Sarah &amp; Constable Quack are on the trail of a biscuit burglar.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Mars As Moon
programme.desc: Mars tries to fill in for a missing Moon, but needs a little coaching from Sarah &amp; Duck.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Detective
programme.desc: Myrtle calls Stanley to help solve the mystery of the Phantom Knitter. Overhearing this, Fifi jumps at the chance to help forming a dynamic, detective duo!

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - First Aid
programme.desc: Myrtle calls Stanley to see if she can practice her first aid skills on him, but he's all fit and healthy. Instead, they go about the town making good use of Myrtle's newfound abilities.

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Jigsaw Puzzle
programme.desc: Jayden decides to draw the ice cream from his jigsaw box. He has trouble copying it, and feels frustrated. Papa finds some thin paper, so Jayden can trace the ice cream picture instead.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Dress Up
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran have fun finding Gran Gran's old clothes. When Charlene brings round a sewing machine, it's time for a Gran Gran plan - they can make JoJo some new clothes too!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Teamwork Badge
programme.desc: A box full of bits and pieces is delivered to the Clubhouse and the Squirrels are excited. Duggee and the Squirrels are going to have to work hard to put it all together. Time for a bit of teamwork.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Pottery Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is having a lovely cup of tea in his favourite cup when Roly surprises him with a very loud peek-a-boo! It is so loud that Duggee jumps and drops his cup which shatters into pieces.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Frog Song
programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Gliding, Argentina
programme.desc: Glitch gatecrashes an academy gliding test, causing calamity in the skies over Argentina.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Runner Beans
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits Theatre, it's the speedy dancing runner beans!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Pak Choi
programme.desc: Pak Choi, who might be known by many names, sings about how she's "Always Pak To You!"

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Banana's Star Appeal
programme.desc: Banana superstar's show is stopped when Pea steals his peel. Supertato races against Evil Pea to get it back but trouble hits when a giant Banana statue collapses onto the stage.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Spooky Day
programme.desc: Supertato runs in fright when Pumpkin tries to make friends with him, but later realises she needs his help as she's stuck in the air hanging from balloons set up by Evil Pea.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - King
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, Dipsy is King. Tinky Winky delivers Tubby Custard and Tubby Toast to King Dipsy - whatever King Dipsy wants! Luckily for Tinky Winky they soon swap places.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from "Fake Ghost Catchers" Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - "Black Leopard". Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of "Black Leopard", except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the "Full Moon Scimitar", on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt "Shaolin Hand Lock" from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own "Eight Diagram Pole Fight" and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become "The Five Shaolin Masters".

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Bloody Escape
programme.desc: Ku is a skilled Kung Fu artist brought up by the bandits and does not agree with the brutal leader of the bandit's camp. He rescues Tong, a young lady forced to become the leader's wife, causing both the authorities and bandits to come after them. Ku has to stand up against the bandits that he grew up with so as to start a new life for himself.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&amp;amp;B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and has to team up with his partner to recover the munitions so as to prevent a disaster from occurring.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Razor
programme.desc: CGTN's brand new science and technology show, covering cutting edge developments from all over the world. RAZOR will show you the world's most powerful laser and the world's smallest anti-cancer treatment. It will take you from the weird world of quantum computing to the boundaries of the cosmos. _x000D_An international team of reporters will follow the guidance of Occam's Razor - the principle that the simplest explanation is the best one.

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

programme.title: Faces of Africa
programme.desc: Faces of Africa is a topical magazine that showcases the diversity of the continent. Faces of Africa is about people. From intimate portraits of ordinary citizens to discussions with political, economic and civic leaders, Faces of Africa features compelling stories from an up close perspective.

programme.title: Talk Africa
programme.desc: Talk Africa is a weekly discussion show that brings the most influential voices in Africa to the world. Broadcast from CGTN’s production center in the Kenyan capital, Nairobi, Talk Africa looks at Africa and the world from an African perspective.

programme.title: Inheritors
programme.desc: Inheritors is a multi-media product from CGTN that shines a light on China’s rich Intangible Cultural Heritage. Each 30-minute TV edition is hosted by a long-term expatriate in China who has a unique understanding of the country’s culture. He or she will introduce viewers to people who are dedicating their lives to its protection, inheritance, innovation, development and promotion.

programme.title: Travelogue
